name: v0.2.1
body:
A fix for PDFs with legacy-font text layers, from upstream `indra-ocr` 1.1.2 (2026-10-20). Same models as 0.2.0. Full record: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

The model weights are Datalab's, under a modified OpenRAIL-M license with use restrictions. Read [LICENSE-STATUS.md](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/blob/main/LICENSE-STATUS.md) before you use them.

## Fixed

- **Legacy-font PDF text layers go to OCR** ([#18](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/pull/18)): many Hindi PDFs are set in Kruti Dev or DevLys, and many Bangla PDFs in Bijoy. Their text layer stores Latin codes while the page shows Devanagari or Bangla, so they read as Latin garbage. Before it trusts a text layer in `auto` mode, the script model now checks up to six of its lines against their images. When almost none agree, OCR reads the page, and `note` says "text layer does not match the page". Upstream reports word accuracy on such Hindi pages going from 0.01-0.20 to 0.85-0.89, at about 5 ms per text-layer page.
- **JSR publish fails fast**: the release job's JSR step stops after 15 minutes instead of hanging when its Deno download stalls.

## Verify this release

```bash
cosign verify-blob ppu-indra-ocr-0.2.1.tgz \
  --bundle ppu-indra-ocr-0.2.1.tgz.sigstore.json \
  --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com

gh attestation verify ppu-indra-ocr-linux-x64.tar.gz --repo PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr
```

Compare: [v0.2.0...v0.2.1](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1)

Built on [Indra OCR](https://github.com/datalab-to/indra) by Datalab (code Apache-2.0, weights modified OpenRAIL-M). This is a community project; Datalab does not endorse it.

name: v0.2.0
body:
Indra OCR 1.1 in TypeScript (2026-10-20): Datalab's new models and the inference code of `indra-ocr` 1.1.1, with the 1.0 models kept as a preset. Full record: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

The model weights are Datalab's, under a modified OpenRAIL-M license with use restrictions. The 1.1 license file is byte for byte the 1.0 one. Read [LICENSE-STATUS.md](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/blob/main/LICENSE-STATUS.md) before you use them.

## Breaking changes

- **Default models are Indra OCR 1.1** (Hugging Face tag `v1.1.0`). `MODEL_REVISION` and `MODEL_BASE_URL` now name them. To keep the 0.1.x models, pass the `v3.1` preset:

```ts
const service = new IndraOcrService({ model: "v3.1" });
```

```bash
ppu-indra-ocr convert scan.png --model v3.1
```

- **`pdfOrder` and `--model-order` are removed**, as upstream 1.1 removed the PDF content order: the order model orders text-layer lines too. Drop the option; there is no replacement.

## New

- **Model presets**: `model: "v1.1"` (default) or `"v3.1"`. Both run on the 1.1 pipeline. `MODEL_PRESETS` lists each preset's pinned commit and files ([Model Presets](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr#model-presets)).
- **80+ languages on scans**: recognizers for CJK, right-to-left scripts (Arabic, Persian, Urdu, Pashto, Hebrew) and other scripts (Indic, Thai, Lao, Khmer, Myanmar, Sinhala, Georgian, Armenian, Ethiopic). A script model routes each line. Right-to-left text comes out in logical order, and a right-to-left page reads its right column first.
- **Handwriting and language models**: the 1.1 Latin recognizer reads handwriting, and n-gram language models re-read lines the recognizer is unsure of. `lm` is on by default in Node and Bun and off on web and React Native; the CLI takes `--no-lm`.
- **Pages at any angle**: deskew covers tilts up to 45 degrees (was 5), and a page set in vertical columns is read in column order with `page.vertical` set.
- **Light text on dark ground** (banners, dark table heads) reads.
- **PDF text layers**: sideways tables and pages turned by `/Rotate` read upright, vertical writing reads in column order, sideways labels become their own lines, and right-to-left text stored in visual order goes to OCR.
- **Models load when needed**: `initialize()` loads about 9 MB; the script recognizers (5 to 10 MB) and language models (12 to 19 MB) load on the first page that needs them. `ppu-indra-ocr download-models` fetches them all up front.
- **Playground** ([ppu-indra-ocr.snowfluke.workers.dev](https://ppu-indra-ocr.snowfluke.workers.dev/)): a model set select, a language models switch, PDF pages drawn with their boxes, and zoom.

## Performance

Pages are slower than in 0.1.2. The 45 degree skew search runs some 80 image rotations, and the main recognizer reads a window three lines tall.

| `convert()` per page (Apple M1, Bun 1.4.2, median of 9) | 0.1.2 | 0.2.0 | Change |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| opencv, two-column page | 290 ms | 397 ms | 37% slower |
| opencv, table page | 244 ms | 310 ms | 27% slower |
| opencv, receipt photo | 156 ms | 203 ms | 30% slower |
| canvas-native, two-column page | 591 ms | 769 ms | 30% slower |
| canvas-native, table page | 499 ms | 571 ms | 14% slower |
| canvas-native, receipt photo | 328 ms | 309 ms | 6% faster |

| Accuracy against transcripts (`bench/vs-paddle.ts`) | 0.1.2 | 0.2.0 | Change |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| token-F1, two-column, rotated and table pages | 1.000 | 1.000 | unchanged |
| token-F1, receipt photo | 0.873 | 0.835 | lower |

The port matches the Python reference: line text, layout blocks and markdown agree exactly on every OCR test page and PDF case on both presets, checked against goldens from `indra-ocr` 1.1.1 ([How the Port Is Checked](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr#how-the-port-is-checked)).

## Verify this release

```bash
cosign verify-blob ppu-indra-ocr-0.2.0.tgz \
  --bundle ppu-indra-ocr-0.2.0.tgz.sigstore.json \
  --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com

gh attestation verify ppu-indra-ocr-linux-x64.tar.gz --repo PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr
```

Compare: [v0.1.2...v0.2.0](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/compare/v0.1.2...v0.2.0)

Built on [Indra OCR](https://github.com/datalab-to/indra) by Datalab (code Apache-2.0, weights modified OpenRAIL-M). This is a community project; Datalab does not endorse it.

name: v0.1.2
body:
Fixes for the standalone CLI binaries, a new playground, and a README that follows ppu-paddle-ocr's (2026-10-17). Full record: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). The library API is unchanged from 0.1.1.

The model weights are Datalab's, under a modified OpenRAIL-M license with use restrictions; read [LICENSE-STATUS.md](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/blob/main/LICENSE-STATUS.md) before you use them.

## Fixed

- **Binaries read PDFs**: the 0.1.1 binaries failed with `Cannot find module '@embedpdf/pdfium/pdfium.wasm'`. `pdfium.wasm` is now embedded, and the release smoke test converts a PDF with every binary on linux-x64, linux-arm64, darwin-arm64 and windows-x64 ([#11](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/pull/11)).
- **Binaries are executable after extraction**: the 0.1.1 Linux and macOS archives packed the binary without the executable bit. No `chmod +x` needed any more ([#11](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/pull/11)).
- **`PPU_INDRA_OCR_PDFIUM_WASM`**: on Node and Bun, point PDF input at a local `pdfium.wasm` instead of `node_modules`.

## Changed

- **Playground** ([ppu-indra-ocr.snowfluke.workers.dev](https://ppu-indra-ocr.snowfluke.workers.dev/)): the ppu-paddle-ocr playground's design and workflow (drag and drop, sample files, model download progress with an in-browser cache, mobile views), plus Indra's pipeline and PDF settings, layout block overlays, Markdown, Text, Lines, Blocks and JSON tabs, per-stage timings and a PDF pager.
- **README**: ppu-paddle-ocr's structure, with a demo image, the standalone binary verification steps, and benchmarks against ppu-paddle-ocr 6.6.1.

## Security

- **`apps/serve` dependencies**: `adm-zip` 0.6.0 to 0.6.1 (seven advisories) and `nanoid` 5.1.11 to 5.1.16 (GHSA-28wg-ghj8-5hjv), both transitive in the REST server's lockfile. A fresh install of the library resolves `adm-zip` 0.6.1 through `onnxruntime-node`; refresh an older lockfile to pick it up. The CI dependency scan now reads that lockfile too ([#12](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/pull/12)).

## Verify this release

```bash
cosign verify-blob ppu-indra-ocr-0.1.2.tgz \
  --bundle ppu-indra-ocr-0.1.2.tgz.sigstore.json \
  --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com

gh attestation verify ppu-indra-ocr-linux-x64.tar.gz --repo PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr
```

Compare: [v0.1.1...v0.1.2](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2)

name: v0.1.1
body:
First release (2026-10-17) of ppu-indra-ocr: a TypeScript SDK for [Indra OCR](https://github.com/datalab-to/indra) by Datalab. It reads images and PDFs into markdown, plain text, or JSON with line boxes and layout blocks, on ONNX Runtime, in Node.js and Bun, with web and React Native entries. Full record: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

This is the first working npm release. The npm upload of 0.1.0 was published from the repository root by mistake, could not be imported, and contained the model weights; it is unpublished. The code is the same as the `v0.1.0` tag.

## Read Datalab's license first

The code is Apache-2.0. The model weights are not: they are Datalab's, under a modified OpenRAIL-M license that you accept when the library downloads them. You may not use the weights at all if your organization had more than USD 20M in revenue last year or has raised more than USD 20M (personal use and research excepted), or if it offers any product or service that competes with Datalab (no exception). [LICENSE-STATUS.md](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/blob/main/LICENSE-STATUS.md) explains the terms, records our unanswered 2026-10-14 request to Datalab, and lists what may change. This is a community project; Datalab does not endorse it.

## Install

```bash
bun add ppu-indra-ocr onnxruntime-node
bun add @embedpdf/pdfium   # only for PDF input
```

JSR: `@snowfluke/ppu-indra-ocr`. Entry points: `ppu-indra-ocr` (Node.js, Bun), `ppu-indra-ocr/web`, `ppu-indra-ocr/mobile`, `ppu-indra-ocr/pdf`. The first `initialize()` downloads about 18 MB of models (38 MB with math) from Datalab's Hugging Face repository, pinned to commit `d7c839c` (tag v3.1).

## Quick start

```ts
import { IndraOcrService } from "ppu-indra-ocr";

const service = new IndraOcrService();
await service.initialize();

const page = await service.convert(await Bun.file("scan.png").arrayBuffer());
console.log(page.markdown);

await service.destroy();
```

On the repository's two-column test page:

```
## Springs of the Eastern Ridge

## 1. Field notes

The survey team walked the eastern ridge in the first week of May. They recorded each spring, its flow in litres per minute, and the colour of the water. Most springs ran clear. Two ran brown after rain and cleared again within a day.
```

The same page from the CLI, as JSON: `ppu-indra-ocr convert scan.png --format json` gives 43 lines and 15 layout blocks, in 624 ms on an Apple Silicon Mac.

## What is in it

- **The whole Indra pipeline in TypeScript**: page orientation, deskew, line detection, Latin and Chinese recognizers with a script router, reading order, layout labels, and markdown with tables as HTML. `convert()` returns a `Page` with `markdown`, `text`, `lines`, `blocks`, `rotation`, `skew` and per-stage `timings`.
- **Every stage as a method**: `orient`, `straighten`, `detect`, `recognize`, `order` and `readMath`, so you can chain your own pipeline. `recognize(image, boxes)` reads boxes from any detector, one line per box; boxes should hug the text.
- **PDF input** (`ppu-indra-ocr/pdf`, pdfium as WebAssembly): uses the PDF text layer where it passes the checks (invisible OCR layers, broken font maps and text with no ink are rejected) and OCR elsewhere.
- **Checked against the Python reference**: on the `opencv` engine, line text, blocks and markdown match `indra-ocr` 0.3.1 exactly on every test page, and line boxes agree to an IoU of 0.98 or better. The `canvas-native` engine (no OpenCV) stays within a token-F1 of 0.98.
- **CLI, REST server and binaries**: `ppu-indra-ocr convert` takes images and PDFs to md, text or JSON; `apps/serve` is a Hono + Bun HTTP API; standalone CLI binaries for Linux, macOS and Windows are attached to this release.
- **Playground**: [ppu-indra-ocr.snowfluke.workers.dev](https://ppu-indra-ocr.snowfluke.workers.dev) runs it in the browser on your own images and PDFs, with no upload.

## Verify this release

The npm package is published with provenance. The packed tarball is attached here with a Sigstore bundle:

```bash
cosign verify-blob ppu-indra-ocr-0.1.1.tgz \
  --bundle ppu-indra-ocr-0.1.1.tgz.sigstore.json \
  --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr/' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
```

A CycloneDX SBOM is attached as `ppu-indra-ocr-sbom.cyclonedx.json`.

## Known issues in the 0.1.1 binaries

- **Not executable after extraction** on Linux and macOS: run `chmod +x ./ppu-indra-ocr-<target>` once. Fixed for the next release.
- **No PDF input** in the standalone binaries (`Cannot find module '@embedpdf/pdfium/pdfium.wasm'`). Use the npm CLI for PDFs until the next release. Images work.

## Known limits

- **Runtimes**: Node.js and Bun are tested. The web entry has automated tests only in Bun with a canvas polyfill (the playground was checked by hand in headless Chromium). The React Native entry is type-checked and has not run on a device.
- **Web opencv engine**: the page must load OpenCV.js itself; only a script tag is tested.
- **Model limits** (from the upstream model card): complex tables, handwriting, scripts outside Latin, Cyrillic, Greek, Devanagari, Bengali and Chinese, degraded scans and vertical text read poorly. See [Limitations](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-indra-ocr#limitations).

## Credits

- **Indra OCR** by [Datalab](https://www.datalab.to): the pipeline is a port of [datalab-to/indra](https://github.com/datalab-to/indra) (Apache-2.0); the weights are Datalab's under their own license. An unmodified mirror with the license and attribution is at [snowfluke/ppu-indra-ocr-models](https://huggingface.co/snowfluke/ppu-indra-ocr-models).
- **Library scaffold** from [ppu-paddle-ocr](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-paddle-ocr); image operations through [ppu-ocv](https://github.com/PT-Perkasa-Pilar-Utama/ppu-ocv) (OpenCV.js); PDF through [@embedpdf/pdfium](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@embedpdf/pdfium); inference on [ONNX Runtime](https://onnxruntime.ai).
- Maintained by @snowfluke.
